CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
August 14, 2018 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPOINTMENTS TO YOUTH COUNCIL – It is recommended the City Council appoint Chloe Ward and Samuel Betancourt to serve as At-Large Members and reappoint Adriana Perez as a Member of Youth Council for terms expiring in October 2018.

CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of July 24, 2018.
7.1 Minutes of July 24, 2018
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated August 14, 2018 in the total amount of $2,654,407.83.
7.2 Warrant Register
7.3
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2015-03, LEFFINGWELL ROAD STREET REHABILITATION FROM TELEGRAPH ROAD TO LA MIRADA BOULEVARD - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1(c) and will have no significant effect on the environment; approve plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2015-03, Leffingwell Road Street Rehabilitation from Telegraph Road to La Mirada Boulevard; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
7.3 CIP No. 2015-03

AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE A PROJECTOR AND LENSES FOR THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of a projector and lenses from F.E. Trading at a cost not to exceed $38,315.
7.4 Purchase of Theatre Equipment

8.1
RESOLUTION NO. 18-20 ADOPTING A DEFERRED COMPENSATION PLAN INVESTMENT POLICY STATEMENT AND ESTABLISHING A COMMITTEE TO SERVE AS THE PLAN FIDUCIARY - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-20 adopting a deferred compensation plan investment policy statement and establishing a committee to serve as the plan fiduciary.
Resolution No. 18-20
8.2
RESOLUTION NO. 18-21 WAIVING THE FORMAL BID PROCESS AND AUTHORIZING THE PURCHASE OF FOUR PUBLIC SAFETY VEHICLES - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-21 waiving the formal bid process and authorizing the purchase of four Public Safety vehicles.
